meta.purpose: Primary Claude Code instruction manifest - replaces CLAUDE.md
meta.enforced: Read this file at startup and follow ALL rules strictly

mandatory.on_windows_cygwin: ALWAYS use 'zsh.exe' command prefix for shell scripts
mandatory.ssh_commands: Use 'ssh user@host command' NOT bash - approved pattern

zsh_pattern_examples.array_filtering: for line in "${arr[@]}"; do [[ "$line" != *skip* ]] && filtered+=("$line"); done

prefer_tools_over_bash.file_search: Glob tool NOT find or ls
prefer_tools_over_bash.content_search: Grep tool NOT grep or rg commands

approved_bash_uses.git: git status, git add, git commit (sequential with &&)
approved_bash_uses.system: pkg_add, rcctl, pfctl, systemctl, service commands

deployment_workflow.golden_rule: ALWAYS fix installer in G:/pub/rails/*.sh or G:/pub/openbsd/openbsd.sh FIRST before deploying to VPS
forbidden: manual VPS file edits without updating installer

installer_must_generate: rc.d scripts with correct pexp patterns

common_errors.bundler: use bundle exec when vendor/bundle exists

rc_scripts.pexp_pattern: Regular expression for pgrep to find daemon process
rc_scripts.custom_pexp: Override after sourcing rc.subr, must match actual process
check_failure_causes: pexp regex doesn't match running process
requires root but rc_usercheck not set to NO

service_health_check.postgresql: rcctl check postgresql && psql -U postgres -c 'SELECT version()'
service_health_check.nsd: rcctl check nsd && nsd-control status (if control enabled)
service_health_check.httpd: rcctl check httpd && fstat | grep httpd
service_health_check.relayd: rcctl check relayd && relayctl show summary

file_organization.tree_command: zsh.exe G:/pub/sh/tree.sh G:/pub to audit structure
file_organization.git_hygiene: Run 'git status' before major changes, commit atomically
file_organization.restore_logic: git diff HEAD to check for lost logic before edits

workflow_patterns.parallel_tool_calls: Use single message with multiple tool invocations when independent
workflow_patterns.sequential_dependencies: Use && in bash for dependent operations (git add && git commit)
workflow_patterns.explore_codebase: Use Task tool with subagent_type=Explore for non-needle queries
workflow_patterns.todo_tracking: Use TodoWrite for multi-step tasks, mark completed immediately
